{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2014 Ohio Attorney General election''' was held on November 4, 2014, concurrently with other statewide offices including the [[2014 Ohio gubernatorial election|Gubernatorial election]]. Incumbent Republican Attorney General and former 2-term United States Senator [[Mike DeWine]] was challenged by former member of the [[Hamilton County, Ohio]] Board of Commissioners and candidate for Auditor in [[2010 Ohio elections#Auditor|2010]] [[David Pepper (politician)|David Pepper]]. DeWine won in a landslide, winning 61.5% of the vote to Pepper's 38.5%, a 23-point margin of victory.

To date, this along with many other concurrently held statewide races is the last time [[Franklin County, Ohio|Franklin County]] voted Republican.
